prions can be transmitted from animals to humans, and that the prion hypothesis has been confirmed by the generation of synthetic prions in vitro and in vivo.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
prions are a new class of infectious agents that can be considered as a paradigm of a protein-based infectious particle.
PrPSc, which is the infectious agent in prion diseases, can be considered as a “molecular chaperone” for the propagation of misfolded proteins in neurodegenerative diseases.
